py2axum.description: py2axum: transpile a FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + Pydantic + aiohttp package to a Rust/axum project.

arguments.help: directory of the FastAPI application package
output directory for the Rust project
import root, like sys.path (default: parent of the package)
experimental: one more import root, like an extra sys.path entry (repeatable): the sibling packages of a monorepo the application installs from its own checkout

the served application, as uvicorn's import string (`api.main:app`, `api.main:create_app`): only that module's FastAPI() is analysed when the package has several entry points (default: every FastAPI() of the package, analysed together)

what stays in a Python process next to the binary (raw routes such as /api/v1/mcp, lifespan; mount: the app's last app.mount() and include_router() of a library's router, which get every request no translated route fully matches); auto: every route that does not translate, and such mounts
==SUPPRESS==
crate name (default: <package>_axum)
buffer list responses instead of streaming them
translate even if the project locks library versions outside the tested ranges
the Python the project runs on (default: its .python-version, else this Python if the project's requires-python allows it); messages and sys.version_info follow it

translate pure-Python libraries of the project's environment from their source (only the functions the routes reach): none (default), auto (every pure-Python distribution under an admitted licence the library map does not cover), or a comma-separated list of distributions
the project's virtual environment, whose site-packages --translate-libs reads (default: a .venv at --root or above, else the environment py2axum runs in)
admit a licence for --translate-libs besides MIT, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, 0BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC, PSF-2.0, Python-2.0, Unlicense, Zlib, HPND, BSD-4-Clause, MPL-2.0 (repeatable)

py2axum watch.description: `py2axum watch`: regenerate, rebuild and restart the binary each time the Python project changes.

arguments.help: directory of the FastAPI application package
output directory of the Rust project
import root, like sys.path (default: parent of the package); the directory watched
crate name (default: <package>_axum)
as for generation (auto is handy while porting: refused routes do not stop the cycle)
buffer list responses instead of streaming them
translate even if the project locks library versions outside the tested ranges
start the binary, and restart it after each successful build
build the release profile (slow: fat LTO); default: the debug profile, incremental
regenerate only (an IDE or another tool builds)
polling interval (default 0.5 s)
quiet time after the last change before a cycle starts (default 0.3 s)
time the binary gets to exit after SIGTERM before it is killed (default 5 s)
the Python the project runs on (default: its .python-version, else this Python if the project's requires-python allows it); messages and sys.version_info follow it

translate pure-Python libraries of the project's environment from their source (only the functions the routes reach): none (default), auto (every pure-Python distribution under an admitted licence the library map does not cover), or a comma-separated list of distributions
the project's virtual environment, whose site-packages --translate-libs reads (default: a .venv at --root or above, else the environment py2axum runs in)
admit a licence for --translate-libs besides MIT, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, 0BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC, PSF-2.0, Python-2.0, Unlicense, Zlib, HPND, BSD-4-Clause, MPL-2.0 (repeatable)
